description: Find House of Lords votes (divisions) by keyword, newest first, with the motion or amendment moved, Content and Not Content totals, which side won, and whether the government won or was defeated. Answers "did the Lords defeat the government on X?". Source: UK Parliament Lords Votes API. Use lords_division_result for the names of peers on each side. (cost: 1 credit)

q.description: string, required, word or phrase to search for, e.g. a bill name such as "Cyber Security"

take.description: int, optional, number of divisions to return, 1-25, default 10

name: lords_division_search
